pages.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 219
Date 3/4/16

April 3rd

Sir,
On April 1st at 6 p.m. a motor car containing
three Chinese and having a Japanese chauffeur
were passing along the road from Zau Oo Ching
to Loongwha when they were challenged by the
soldiers. The occupants of the car tried to force
their way through, were arrested and detained
until about 10 p.m. on the same date when they
were released upon some foreigners, said to be
from the Chartered Bank, appearing and claiming
that the Chinese were their employees.

Your Obedient Servant,

Wk

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.
pages.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记簿
编号 219
日期 16年4月3日

4月3日

先生：

4月1日下午6时，一辆载有三名中国人、由一名日本司机驾驶的汽车，在从曹家渡（Zau Oo Ching）驶往龙华（Loongwha）的途中，受到士兵的盘查。车内人员试图强行通过，随即被逮捕并拘留，直至同日晚上约10时，据称来自麦加利银行（Chartered Bank）的几名外国人出面，声称这些中国人是其雇员，他们才得以释放。

您忠实的仆人，

Wk

首席探长

警务处总监
